plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's mind. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This connection often feels good from the start. There may be something about the way this person speaks that puts you at ease. Their words can make you feel seen, appreciated, and understood. After spending time with them, you may walk away feeling a little lighter, a little more confident, or simply more like yourself.

When this aspect flows well, conversation becomes a source of connection. You encourage each other naturally. You may spend hours sharing ideas, talking about your hopes, or reflecting on life together. There is often a feeling that this person understands where you're coming from, and that feeling can be deeply attractive.

You may also find that your values align in meaningful ways. What matters to you matters to them.

The downside is that comfort can become a habit. When things are easy between you, it's tempting to stick to what feels good and avoid the conversations that are messier, riskier, or harder to navigate.

One of the gifts of this connection is that you naturally help each other feel seen and valued. That creates a strong foundation. The opportunity is to build on it.
